forces.title: Photonics innovation critical for AI cost reduction, boosting networking demand
forces.description: McKinsey highlights innovation roadmaps in 'networking/photonics' as essential for achieving three to four orders of magnitude cost reduction in AI inference. This cost reduction is a critical condition for broadening AI adoption and sustaining high demand for semiconductors, especially for AI data centers, which will drive significant investment in advanced optical networking equipment (part of IN080303) to enable high-speed data transmission.
forces.source_title: The $2.3 trillion horizon: How AI is rewriting the semiconductor story

demand_drivers.description: Hyperscalers are planning massive capital expenditures of approximately $800 billion for 2026 and $1 trillion for 2027, predominantly for AI infrastructure, which fuels unprecedented demand for high-performance networking and optical solutions.

new_opportunities.description: Innovations in networking/photonics are crucial for achieving significant cost reductions (three to four orders of magnitude) in AI inference. These advancements broaden AI adoption and sustain high demand for underlying technology, creating opportunities for advanced optical networking equipment in data centers.

market_sizing.methodology: Analysis of demand drivers and new opportunities for Communications & Networking Equipment, particularly optical networking, stemming from the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and the necessity for cost reductions in AI inference.
market_sizing.source_title: The $2.3 trillion horizon: How AI is rewriting the semiconductor story
